definitions.explanation: Metal money as opposed to paper money.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自動|じどう}{販売|はんばい}{機|き}→自動販売機：03078_jidouhanbaiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{硬貨|こうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put coins into the vending machine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{硬貨|こうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have a lot of coins in my wallet.

notes:
{硬貨|こうか} refers to metal coins.

JAPANESE COINS:
- 1⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧{硬貨|こうか} (1-yen coin - aluminum)
- 5⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧{硬貨|こうか} (5-yen coin - brass, has a hole)
- 10⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧{硬貨|こうか} (10-yen coin - bronze)
- 50⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧{硬貨|こうか} (50-yen coin - cupronickel, has a hole)
- 100⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧{硬貨|こうか} (100-yen coin - cupronickel)
- 500⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧{硬貨|こうか} (500-yen coin - nickel-brass)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {硬貨|こうか} (coins) ↔ ⟦{紙幣|しへい}→紙幣：00363_shihei⟧/⟦{札|さつ}→札：02153_satsu⟧ (paper money, bills)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{小銭|こぜに}→小銭：02759_kozeni⟧ (coins, small change - casual term)
